# Battlefield

  
  

## Overview

**Battlefield** is a Swiss-army toolkit designed to define and extract
spatial spots from specific regions in spatial transcriptomics data. It
provides low-level, modular utilities to delineate spatial regions of
interest,  
including **interfaces between clusters**, **intra-cluster layers**,
and  
**inter-cluster trajectories**. These utilities are intended to be
reused and composed within higher-level  
analytical workflows and packages. `Battlefield` supports
sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics platforms such as  
**10x Genomics Visium**, across multiple resolutions, including  
Visium HD (binned).

![](reference/figures/workflow.png)

**Battlefield** provides four core functionalities to define and extract
spatial transcriptomics spots from specific tissue regions, enabling the
study of spatial organization under different biological contexts:

- **Interfaces between clusters** — identify and analyze boundary
  regions where distinct tissue or cell populations interact.

- **Intra-cluster layers** — characterize spatial layers or gradients
  within a single cluster.

- **Inter-cluster trajectories** — model spatial transitions across
  multiple clusters.

- **Cluster neighbourhood** — report the cluster composition of a
  spatial neighborhood defined by k nearest spots, constrained by a
  distance threshold.

It can be integrated upstream to support insightful ligand–receptor
analyses, using BulkSignalR, available from Bioconductor
[here](https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/BulkSignalR.html).

Data summary functions are proposed to help defining spatial regions of
interest on the top of previously defined clusters.

## Installation

``` r

# Battlefield directly from Bioconductor.
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("Battlefield")

# or development version via GitHub:
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("ZheFrench/Battlefield",build_vignettes = TRUE)

# To read the vignette
# browseVignettes("Battlefield")
```

## Changes

Major changes are reported in the [NEWS
file](https://github.com/ZheFrench/Battlefield/blob/master/NEWS), make
sure to check it out if you want to follow the latest developments.

## Issues and bug reports

Please use <https://github.com/ZheFrench/Battlefield/issues> to submit
issues, bug reports, and comments.

**Battlefield** has been successfully installed on Mac OS X, Linux, and
Windows using R version 4.5.

The code in this repository is published with the
[CeCILL](https://github.com/ZheFrench/Battlefield/blob/master/LICENSE.md)
License.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_borders_to_spe()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/add_borders_to_spe.md)
  : Add border or core spot selections to SpatialExperiment colData
- [`add_layers_to_spe()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/add_layers_to_spe.md)
  : Add layer classifications to SpatialExperiment colData
- [`add_trajectories_to_spe()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/add_trajectories_to_spe.md)
  : Add trajectory information to SpatialExperiment colData
- [`adjacent_endpoint()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/adjacent_endpoint.md)
  : Pick a point adjacent to a selected endpoint, on a given side of a
  segment
- [`bresenham_line()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/bresenham_line.md)
  : Rasterize a line between two points using Bresenham's algorithm
- [`build_all_borders()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/build_all_borders.md)
  : Build border spots for all oriented cluster pairs
- [`build_all_cores()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/build_all_cores.md)
  : Build core spots for all oriented cluster pairs
- [`build_one_line()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/build_one_line.md)
  : Build a single line of spots along a segment
- [`build_one_trajectory()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/build_one_trajectory.md)
  : Select spots near a segment and order them along the segment
- [`build_similar_trajectories()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/build_similar_trajectories.md)
  : Build parallel spot lines around a central segment
- [`closest_spot()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/closest_spot.md)
  : Find the closest spot to a target point
- [`compute_centroids()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/compute_centroids.md)
  : Compute cluster centroids (mean x/y per cluster)
- [`count_all_inlaids()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/count_all_inlaids.md)
  : Count inlaid composition for all clusters
- [`count_all_neighborhoods()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/count_all_neighborhoods.md)
  : Count neighborhood composition for all clusters
- [`count_inlaid()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/count_inlaid.md)
  : Count inlaid composition within a source cluster
- [`count_neighborhood()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/count_neighborhood.md)
  : Count annotated spot types in the neighborhood of a cluster or point
- [`create_all_layers()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/create_all_layers.md)
  : Create and visualize layers for multiple clusters
- [`create_cluster_layers()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/create_cluster_layers.md)
  : Create layer classification for spots in a cluster
- [`detect_grid_type()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/detect_grid_type.md)
  : Detect the grid type (square vs hexagonal) from spatial coordinates
- [`directed_cluster_interface_pairs()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/directed_cluster_interface_pairs.md)
  : Build all oriented cluster pairs (A -\> B) and their directed_pair
  labels
- [`estimate_spot_spacing()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/estimate_spot_spacing.md)
  : Estimate spot spacing from nearest-neighbor distances
- [`filter_out_by_endpoint_clusters()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/filter_out_by_endpoint_clusters.md)
  : Filter lines by endpoint cluster membership
- [`get_inlaid_spots()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/get_inlaid_spots.md)
  : Get inlaid spots within a source cluster
- [`get_neighborhood_params()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/get_neighborhood_params.md)
  : Suggest neighborhood parameters based on detected grid type
- [`get_neighborhood_spots()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/get_neighborhood_spots.md)
  : Get neighborhood spots around a target cluster or point
- [`point_segment_distance_vec()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/point_segment_distance_vec.md)
  : Point-to-segment distance (vectorized)
- [`remove_used_points()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/remove_used_points.md)
  : Remove rows whose rounded (x, y) coordinates have already been used
- [`select_border_spots()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/select_border_spots.md)
  : Select border spots from cluster A that touch cluster B (and flag
  junctions)
- [`select_core_spots()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/select_core_spots.md)
  : Select core (non-interface) spots for a directed pair
- [`shift_point()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/shift_point.md)
  : Shift a point along a given direction vector
- [`unit_normal_left()`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/unit_normal_left.md)
  : Compute the left unit normal of the directed segment A-\>B
- [`visiumHD_16um_simulated_spe`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/visiumHD_16um_simulated_spe.md)
  : Simulated VisiumHD 16 µm binned SpatialExperiment dataset
- [`visiumHD_simulated_spe`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/visiumHD_simulated_spe.md)
  : Simulated VisiumHD 8 µm binned SpatialExperiment dataset
- [`visium_simulated_spe`](https://zhefrench.github.io/Battlefield/reference/visium_simulated_spe.md)
  : Simulated Visium SpatialExperiment dataset
